guitar.modelsText: Lowden/Sheeran signature model (Little Lula) and Martin LX1E (Little Martin)
models: Sheeran signature model (Little Lula) and Martin LX1E (Little Martin)
guitar.evidence: Ed Sheeran is closely identified with his small Martin LX1E ('Little Martin') travel guitar and later his Sheeran by Lowden signature models; widely documented.

tone.target: clean acoustic-pop strum with light stereo sheen
tone.profile: clean acoustic-pop strum with light stereo sheen
tone.summary: A bright, clean signal chain emphasizing compression for attack, followed by a classic US Deluxe tone with Chorus and gentle Room reverb for pop sheen.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and overall acoustic body by swapping the default IR for a more natural, open-air sound.

proposals.reason: The current US 2x12 is too enclosed; an acoustic IR will enhance the 'acoustic guitar feel'.
proposals.expectedGain: More natural body and less boxiness.
